description:
No spec subject (environment/config wiring; the forensics behavior it feeds is specled.verify.command_output_capture_dir).

Follow-up from specled_-td7, found by its round-2 cold verifier (2026-07-27).

specled_-td7 armed SPECLED_COMMAND_OUTPUT_DIR in every gate path the repo owns. Two of the three are unconditional (CI; the make check / scripts/check_specs.sh wrappers). The third is not, and the ADR now says so rather than overclaiming.

.claude/settings.json only reaches agent sessions whose PROJECT DIRECTORY is a checkout carrying that file. MEASURED during td7: in an agent session rooted at the primary checkout (on main, which does not yet carry the change), SPECLED_COMMAND_OUTPUT_DIR is unset even when cwd is inside the stage worktree. That is plausibly the exact shape of session in which the original flakes were observed, so the primary use case is the least covered one. After this branch merges to main the primary checkout will carry it, which closes most of the gap - but not for sessions already running, and not across sibling worktrees created from an older base.

Second, narrower issue: the settings.json value is RELATIVE (tmp/specled-command-output), so it resolves against whatever directory the gate was invoked from. An agent running mix spec.check from a subdirectory writes captures there instead of at the repo root. td7 mitigated the gitignore consequence (**/tmp/specled-command-output/ now covers subdirectories) but not the scattering itself.

Options worth weighing, none obviously right:
- absolute path via a settings.json variable expansion, if the harness supports it in env values (unverified - td7 chose relative specifically because expansion was not confirmed)
- make scripts/check_specs.sh the documented agent-facing gate command instead of bare mix spec.check, so the wrapper (which already defaults the variable against $ROOT) is always in the path
- accept and document, on the grounds that CI is where non-reproducing failures most need capturing

Not a blocker for td7: the wrapper and CI legs work and were verified by execution.

comments.text:
CORRECTION to this ticket's own description, before anyone acts on it.

The 'Second, narrower issue' paragraph — that an agent running mix spec.check from a subdirectory writes captures there instead of at the repo root — is FALSE. Found by the specled_-td7 round-2 verifier and confirmed by my own execution:

  mix spec.check from lib/deep/sub  -> ** (Mix) The task "spec.check" could not be found (no mix.exs in the current directory; mix does not walk up)
  mix test from a subdirectory      -> ** (Mix) Could not find a Mix.Project
  make check from lib               -> make: *** No rule to make target 'check'
  bash scripts/check_specs.sh from lib -> works, because line 5 cd's to the git toplevel

No gate path in this repo can run with cwd != repo root, so the relative settings value always resolves at the root and the scattering scenario has no reachable invocation. Disregard that paragraph. The gitignore rule specled_-td7 added for it is harmless defense-in-depth and its comment has been corrected to say so rather than describing a live hazard.

Also: the option bullet 'make scripts/check_specs.sh the documented agent-facing gate command' is already DONE — .spec/AGENTS.md now tells agents to use it when they want the capture guaranteed.

What remains genuinely open, and is the whole of this ticket: .claude/settings.json reaches only sessions whose project directory is a checkout carrying that file. A session rooted at an older checkout does not inherit it — measured during td7, in a session rooted at the primary checkout on main. Merging td7 closes most of it; sessions already running, and worktrees created from an older base, stay uncovered.

Session: a5f50a6d-689f-4616-80ad-806b0595aa28
Log: /Users/mz/.claude-personal/projects/-Users-mz-src-specled-ex/a5f50a6d-689f-4616-80ad-806b0595aa28.jsonl

ADMISSION VERIFICATION (specled_-k6s, 2026-07-27)
Cold fresh-context verifier run against the epic base tree (feat/specled_-td7-self-identifying-descriptors @ e81f9f98).

VERDICT: partially_done   EFFORT: small

== MANDATE AS ADMITTED (implement THIS, not the original description) ==
Three concrete items; no further discovery needed.

A. Put the armed gate command in the always-loaded rule surfaces (this is the real reach win: CLAUDE.md/.claude/rules discovery is cwd-based, whereas settings.json `env` is project-dir-based, so guidance placed here reaches sessions the settings file cannot).
   - `.claude/rules/specled.md:30-32` — in the "heaviest" rung, change the pre-PR preflight invocation from bare `mix spec.check` to `bash ./scripts/check_specs.sh` (equivalently `make check`), with one sentence: the wrapper arms SPECLED_COMMAND_OUTPUT_DIR at $ROOT/tmp/specled-command-output so a failing or timed-out verification leaves forensics; bare `mix spec.check` in a session whose project directory is a checkout without .claude/settings.json leaves nothing.
   - `.claude/rules/specled.md:34-35` — replace or augment the container-repo `make spec-check` / `make spec-check-full` example with this repo's actual `make check` target (Makefile:63).
   - `.claude/rules/specled.md:61` — same substitution in "Verification Gate".
   - `CLAUDE.md:35` and `CLAUDE.md:46` (merge-gate checkbox) — same substitution.
   End state: an agent that has loaded only CLAUDE.md + .claude/rules/specled.md, in a session rooted anywhere, is told to run the wrapper, so the arming no longer depends on which checkout the session was rooted at.

B. Close the open option in the ADR rather than leaving it open. In `.spec/decisions/specled.decision.gate_failure_forensics.md`, "Alternatives Rejected" section, add a bullet recording the absolute-path decision: either (i) verify whether Claude Code expands `$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR` inside settings.json `env` values and, if it does not, state that as the reason the value stays relative; or (ii) state that even if expansion worked, an absolute value would pin captures to the session's project directory rather than the worktree the gate actually ran in, which is worse for the multi-worktree workflow this repo uses — hence relative is chosen deliberately, not by default. Either form is acceptable; the requirement is that `.claude/settings.json` stays as-is with a recorded rationale instead of an unweighed option.

C. Remove the dangling forward references once the ticket closes: `.spec/AGENTS.md:46` ("See specled_-4f7.") and `.spec/decisions/specled.decision.gate_failure_forensics.md:70` ("see specled_-4f7 for the residual"). Replace with a statement of the residual itself (agent-shell coverage depends on the session's project directory; run the wrapper if you need the capture guaranteed) so the docs stand without a ticket lookup.

Explicitly OUT of scope / do not do: nothing in `lib/specled_ex/verifier.ex` (capture stays opt-in per ADR:60-63 — do not add an unarmed-capture warning, that would change library behavior for consumers and is not what this ticket asks); nothing in `.gitignore` (already corrected); no change to `.claude/settings.json` content.

== EVIDENCE ==
TICKET DESCRIPTION vs TREE, claim by claim.

(1) "Second, narrower issue" (relative path scatters captures when the gate runs from a subdirectory) — already RETRACTED by the ticket's own 2026-07-27T01:27:57Z comment, and the tree already reflects the retraction. `.gitignore:19-26`: "Gate forensics (SPECLED_COMMAND_OUTPUT_DIR). Defense in depth, not a case that arises today: the agent-shell default in .claude/settings.json is a RELATIVE path, but every gate path refuses to run outside the repo root (`mix` wants a mix.exs, `make` a Makefile, check_specs.sh cd's to the git toplevel)". `.spec/decisions/specled.decision.gate_failure_forensics.md:72-78` states the same and adds "If a future gate path can be invoked from a subdirectory, that relative value starts scattering captures and must become absolute." Nothing left here.

(2) Option "make scripts/check_specs.sh the documented agent-facing gate command" — LANDED, but ONLY in `.spec/AGENTS.md:43-47`: "If you are running the gate as an agent and want the capture guaranteed, run `bash ./scripts/check_specs.sh` rather than bare `mix spec.check`, or check `echo $SPECLED_COMMAND_OUTPUT_DIR` first. See specled_-4f7." It did NOT land in the always-loaded rule surfaces, which are what agents actually follow:
  - `CLAUDE.md:35` "The verification gate before closing a task is `mix spec.check`."
  - `CLAUDE.md:46` merge-gate checkbox "- [ ] `mix spec.check`"
  - `.claude/rules/specled.md:30-32` "`mix spec.check` (bare) — heaviest. … Reserve for pre-PR preflight only."
  - `.claude/rules/specled.md:61` "Before closing a task, `mix spec.check` must pass…"
  - `.claude/rules/specled.md:34-35` names container-repo targets `make spec-check` / `make spec-check-full` as the make equivalents; this repo's actual armed target is `check` (`Makefile:61-64`: `SPECLED_COMMAND_OUTPUT_DIR ?= $(CURDIR)/tmp/specled-command-output`, `check: export SPECLED_COMMAND_OUTPUT_DIR := …`). No always-loaded file mentions `make check` or `scripts/check_specs.sh` at all.

(3) Option "accept and document" — LANDED in the ADR, `.spec/decisions/specled.decision.gate_failure_forensics.md:62-70`: "`.claude/settings.json` arms agent shells only for sessions whose project directory is a checkout carrying this file … Coverage of the agent-shell path is therefore a property of where the session was started, not a guarantee; see specled_-4f7 for the residual."

(4) Option "absolute path via settings.json variable expansion" — NOT done and NOT decided. `.claude/settings.json:2-4` is still `{"env": {"SPECLED_COMMAND_OUTPUT_DIR": "tmp/specled-command-output"}}` (added on this branch; `git diff main..HEAD -- .claude/settings.json` shows the whole `env` block is new in 17b63ff6/td7). The ADR justifies relative but never records absolute-via-expansion as a rejected alternative.

(5) The residual the comment calls "the whole of this ticket" is LIVE AND REPRODUCING RIGHT NOW. Measured in this verification session (project dir = /Users/mz/src/specled_ex, the primary checkout on main, which lacks the env block):
    CWD=/Users/mz/src/specled_ex
    PROJ=            (CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR empty)
    VAR=[UNSET]      (SPECLED_COMMAND_OUTPUT_DIR)
So the ticket's factual premise is TRUE, not stale — but it is a structural property of Claude Code settings resolution, not a repo defect, and the repo-side mitigations for it are the three options above.

(6) Not a realization-hash concern: `.spec/realization_hashes.json` contains no entry mentioning CLAUDE.md, .claude/rules, scripts/check_specs.sh, .spec/AGENTS.md, gate_failure_forensics, settings.json, or Makefile (checked by JSON substring scan — all False).

(7) `.spec/AGENTS.md:46` and the ADR line above both contain forward references "See specled_-4f7." / "see specled_-4f7 for the residual" that will dangle once this ticket closes.

== RISK NOTES ==
REALIZATION HASH: no risk. Scanned .spec/realization_hashes.json for CLAUDE.md, .claude/rules, check_specs, AGENTS.md, gate_failure_forensics, settings.json, Makefile — none present. No lib/ or test/ file is touched, so the realization-drift gate is not engaged.

SPEC REQUIREMENT IDS: none edited. specled.verify.command_output_capture_dir (.spec/specs/verification.spec.md:137-150) and specled.verify.command_capture_run_provenance (:152+) are the behaviors this ticket feeds but their statements need no change; this is env/config wiring plus ADR/doc prose.

DOC-LINT SCOPE: test/docs_identifier_lint_test.exs:204 lints `.spec/**/*.md` (guidance_files() ++ Path.wildcard(".spec/**/*.md")) and :208 lints `.spec/decisions/**/*.md` for finding-code integrity. Items B and C edit both surfaces — keep the prose free of anything that reads as a finding code, or the lint reddens. CLAUDE.md and .claude/rules/* are NOT in doc-lint scope (guidance_files() at :216 is skills/**, docs/**, README.md only).

FILE CONFLICT — specled_-pii: edits `.claude/rules/specled.md:46` (`bw list --grep "Advances:.*<subject.id>"` → literal form) and `.claude/rules/beadwork.md:15,27`. This ticket edits `.claude/rules/specled.md` lines 30-35 and 61. Same file, disjoint regions, but in a single PR the two must be sequenced or merged by hand. Suggest landing pii first (single-line change) and rebasing this one on it.

ADJACENT BUT NOT CONFLICTING: specled_-chb edits lib/specled_ex/verifier.ex:2404-2405 (the forensic-capture comment) — same feature, different file; verify it did not also re-narrate the ADR. specled_-ehv edits the cross_vm_temp_names ADRs, not gate_failure_forensics. specled_-zek touches verification.spec.md prose for findings_echo_exunit_seed and the stderr capture-failure warning — different requirement ids in the same spec file; this ticket touches no spec file, so no collision.

ORDERING: no hard dependency on any other ticket. Item A's premise (that .spec/AGENTS.md already documents the wrapper) is satisfied on this branch by commit 195be63e; do not re-derive it.

CAVEAT FOR THE ORCHESTRATOR: item A does not eliminate the underlying gap, it narrows it. A session rooted at an old checkout AND cwd'd outside any checkout carrying the updated rules still runs unarmed. That is not closable from inside this repo. If the acceptance criterion for this ticket is "the residual is gone," it is unachievable and the ticket should be closed as accepted-and-documented after items B and C. If the criterion is "the repo does everything it can," items A+B+C are the whole of it.

SCOPE CONTRACT (orchestrator, specled_-k6s — 2026-07-27)

Authoritative for mechanical scope checks. Supplements, does not replace, the
ADMISSION VERIFICATION comment's mandate (items A, B, C), which SUPERSEDES this
ticket's description — the description's "second, narrower issue" was already
retracted by the ticket's own 2026-07-27T01:27:57Z comment and is fixed in the tree.

## Allowed touches
- `.claude/rules/specled.md` — the three named sites (cadence-ladder "heaviest" rung,
  the make-target example, and the Verification Gate section).
- `CLAUDE.md` — the two named sites (the verification-gate sentence and the merge-gate
  checkbox).
- `.spec/decisions/specled.decision.gate_failure_forensics.md` — item B (add the
  absolute-path bullet under "Alternatives Rejected") and item C (replace the dangling
  `specled_-4f7` forward reference with a statement of the residual itself).
- `.spec/AGENTS.md` — item C only: replace "See specled_-4f7." with the residual.

REBASE NOTE: specled_-pii has ALREADY LANDED edits to `.claude/rules/specled.md` on the
epic branch (it rewrote the `bw list --grep` line). Your stage is cut from the current
epic head, so you have pii's version. Re-read the file on your base and match by
CONTENT, not by the line numbers the admission comment cites — they have moved.

## Out of Scope (files)
- `lib/specled_ex/verifier.ex` — explicit: capture stays opt-in per the ADR. Do NOT add
  an unarmed-capture warning; that changes library behavior for consumers and is not
  what this ticket asks.
- `.claude/settings.json` — its CONTENT must not change. The whole point of item B is to
  record why it stays as-is.
- `.gitignore` — already corrected.
- `CHANGELOG.md` (orchestrator consolidates once at the end), `VERSION`,
  `.spec/realization_hashes.json`, `.spec/state.json`.
- Every file not listed under Allowed touches.

## AGENT-RULES CAVEAT
`.claude/rules/specled.md` carries `<!-- agent-rules: generated v0.13.2 -->`. Edit IN
PLACE and leave the marker as `generated` — do NOT flip it to `ejected`. Same
orchestrator decision as specled_-pii; the PR body carries the note that both tickets'
changes need upstreaming at the next agent-rules resync.

## Out of Scope (intent)
- No code, no tests, no new dependencies.
- Item B requires a DECISION, not a deferral. Either verify whether Claude Code expands
  `$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR` inside settings.json `env` values and record the finding, or
  record the multi-worktree argument (an absolute value pins captures to the session's
  project directory rather than the worktree the gate actually ran in). Writing "this
  remains open" does not satisfy it.
- Item C must leave the docs standing WITHOUT a ticket lookup. Replacing one dangling
  ticket reference with another is a bounce.
- Do not weaken spec prose or add a false `decisions:` link to quiet branch-guard.

## Verification (change-scoped, run-until-green; host mix, no compose)
1. `mix compile --warnings-as-errors`
2. `mix format --check-formatted`
3. `mix spec.check --no-run-commands`
4. PROVE ITEM A BY EXECUTION, do not assert it: run `bash ./scripts/check_specs.sh`
   (or `make check`) and show that `SPECLED_COMMAND_OUTPUT_DIR` is actually armed under
   it — e.g. capture the value the wrapper exports, and confirm the directory the docs
   now name is the directory the wrapper actually uses. A doc change that points agents
   at a command whose behavior was never checked is the same defect class this ticket
   exists to fix.
5. Confirm no dangling `specled_-4f7` reference survives anywhere in the tree:
   `grep -rn "specled_-4f7" --exclude-dir=.git .` should return only CHANGELOG-style
   historical attributions, if any.

Do NOT run bare `mix spec.check` and do NOT run the full suite. The orchestrator owns
whole-system proof at the merge gate and PR CI.

title: Gate forensics: the agent-shell arming path is conditional on session root and cwd
